name: quest-event-array
description: Issue #410 regression: athlete reports two separate quest completions in one ordinary message - both must land as separate entries in the quest_event array, not just the first. G1: converted from mode=closing to mode=ordinary - closing no longer exists (C1), and quest_event was never actually closing-gated, only the transcript's framing was. K1 testing pass (2026-09-04) live finding: dropped coachNoteReported - same shape as #12's own precedent. A live run fired quest_event with no coach_note (2/5 flash), which coachTurn.ts's ACTIONS_REQUIRING_COACH_NOTE reprompt (C2) exists specifically to catch and fix in production (already covered by coachTurn-reprompt.test.ts, mocked and deterministic); this harness calls askGemini() directly and never exercises that reprompt (see this file's header comment), so asserting single-shot compliance here just reproduces #670's baseline noise on a case production already self-heals. quest_event itself fired correctly in all 5 runs - no real gap.
